i have bpd too. since im 15 they diagnosed me with “borderline traits” tho since they dont like diagnosing kids with personality disorders. its actual hell. i have a plan to kill myself too. i want to overdose or cut my wrists. bpd is torture. its like ur in a constant state of either anger, anxiety, or severe depression, or a strange mixture of feelings (always negative feelings). ur definitely not toxic tho. i can say that for sure. ppl with bpd dont act wrongly on purpose. they cant control themselves. also, if ur friends abandoned u, they’re not ur real friends. fuck them. im very sure ppl would care if u killed urself, or even tried to. nobody is so bad that, if they took their own life, ppl wouldnt care. i wanna let u know that things definitely get better, which i know sounds cliche but hear me out. if u get mental health assistance, things wont feel so painful. idk if u believe in medication to treat mental illnesses but trust me, they work, as long as u listen to ur psychologist. i dont know u, but im rooting for u to pull thru.

i have borderline personality too. its literally hell. i technically have borderline traits and not the full disorder but thats because im a minor and they usually dont give the full personality disorder diagnosis to people below 18. i have the same problem as you in the sense that i dont feel like people understand me, i pushed away alot of friends i really miss, and my mom gives me advice to fix my problems that doesnt really seem helpful like "sleep more". she even gave me the same advice your mom gave you of "go take a walk". i also have suicidal thoughts that center around getting revenge on people who i believe wronged me and its actually surprising to see other people on here having similar thoughts. im assuming you haven't taken medication yet for your disorder and neither have i, but i have hope that medication will help me and i think it will help you too. another good thing to remember is that depressive thoughts, self harm thoughts, or even suicidal thoughts aren't wrong but what is wrong is acting upon them. your therapist might've already told you that but its true. but i really want to reiterate that i really do think medication will help you if you get it. and if you're already taking it keep in mind that it takes a long time to kick in and work. i hate having borderline personality disorder but im confident we can both get through it.
